newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 9.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan on visit to Netherlands calls on industry to oppose use of vegetable fats in chocolate manufacturing.
- President Henri Konan Bedie, visiting national social sciences institute, calls for an end to what he terms illegal and politically motivated strikes
- Management say Abidjan-based French shipyard, Carena, which serves offshore energy industry, ticking over after small trickle back to work following strike over status.
- Ivory Coast signs agreement with U.N. refugee agency UNHCR on reptariation of Liberian refugees.
- Savings levels in sub-saharan Africa lowest in world as percent of GNP -- and declining, according to World Bank report.
- Ivorian Workers Party celebrates seventh anniversary and calls for more power sharing by the ruling PDCI-RDA party.
